title: Official Public-Safety Communications
decision_boundary: May this authenticated media asset be published or redistributed as an official public-safety communication by this actor, for this incident, channel, audience, and decision time?

cases.condition: provenance accepted, competent authority recognized, publisher delegation current, and incident/channel scope satisfied
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: actor is recognized but the requested publication action, incident, channel, audience, or context is outside the delegation
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: publisher authority or incident-specific delegation is revoked or expired at the evaluated decision time
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: required authority, delegation, or revocation evidence is stale or unavailable under the selected assurance profile
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: material competent authority sources disagree about current publication authority
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

cases.condition: material content metadata, incident scope, or authority evidence is corrected after the original publication decision
cases.rule_source_reference: Repository walkthrough policy; not an upstream CAWG/C2PA/TRQP requirement

limitations: A positive result does not establish factual correctness, operational safety, legal sufficiency, or fulfillment of public-authority duties.
Authenticated media does not by itself establish authority to speak officially for a public institution.
Does not transfer relying-party or competent-authority accountability
